A long diagonal crack running up from the door frame looks serious, but it’s fixable. 🛠️ Clean out the loose plaster, fill the crack with spray foam in thin layers, level it flat, reinforce with mesh tape, cover with putty, sand smooth, and repaint with two coats. Watch this terracotta wall go from cracked to flawless. ✨🏡

caption.text:
Celine Dion might be having more fun than her teenagers! 🤘😂 The Canadian superstar, 58, rocked out to Metallica at Las Vegas’s Sphere with her 16-year-old twin sons, Nelson and Eddy. 
And there’s a sweet family connection: “Eddy, one of my twins, his favourite band is Metallica,” Celine revealed earlier this year. Clearly, mom’s on board! ❤️

📽️: psushawn

caption.text:
Some parents never got to chase their dreams because they were too busy paying for yours. 🎓🙏

They worked the jobs nobody claps for. Delivering, cleaning, driving, lifting, standing on their feet for 12 hours. They came home tired, sore and quiet, then got up and did it all again the next morning so you could have the chances they never did.

There’s no shame in any of it. Every uniform, every early shift and every job people looked down on was a brick in the life you’re living now. Your schooling, your opportunities, your future, all of it was paid for with their sacrifice.

You can’t pay that back with money. The only way to repay it is to become someone they’re proud of, and to never forget where you came from.

Make your life the proof that every sacrifice they made was worth it.

Follow @Wealth to learn valuable advice every time you open Instagram. ⭐

#Wealth #Parents #Sacrifice #Family #LifeLessons

caption.text:
BOOKS, PODCASTS, COLLEAGUES & FRIENDS 

Last week we wrapped up the final live event for this phase of the Protocols: An Operating Manual for the Human Body, tour. 

Six weeks of podcast guest appearances, TV, live events in NYC, Austin, LA & SF. 

Last week I had the great pleasure of guest teaching alongside @scicomm (parent company to the HLP) co-founder @rmohr in a new course @stanford: The Creator Economy. 

The course director is the amazing @mattabrahams — a colleague of mine at @stanfordgsb and one of the world experts in public speaking and communication. His book Think Faster Talk Smarter is simply awesome. 

The course he started at Stanford includes greats like @markrober @mrbeast also guest lecturing. 

Matt was a guest on my podcast a while back and his episode is still one of the most popular HLPs ever— and with good reason; he teaches you how to be an effective communicator in different environments— not just public speaking.

Turns out, Matt and I both published books with @simonandschuster @_simonelement so here we are displaying those.

I own and love Matt’s book. If you’re interested in being a better communicator using data supported tools check it out. You can find it and Protocols wherever books are sold.

The world of public education is massively changed, and all the different forms of communication: podcast, social media, etc., are growing in their relevance. 

It’s been an honor and a thrill to be part of that evolution.

Thank you to all who came out for the live shows, who are reading and posting reviews about the book, to all the podcast listeners, hosts, Stanford and to you here on IG. 

We have a lot more planned to expand the public education effort on health and performance and more, so stay tuned.

And as always, thank you for your interest in science!

@stanford @stanford.med 
#neuroscience #science #ciencia #neurociencia book

caption.text:
“The best revenge is none. Don’t. Ever. Become. Like. Them.” 🖤

A few words on the skin can carry years of experience.

When someone hurts you, disrespects you, or takes your kindness for granted, the temptation to return that same energy can be real. You want them to understand what they put you through. You want accountability. You want the apology that actually acknowledges the damage.

But how much more of your time are you willing to give to what already hurt you?

There’s strength in deciding that someone else’s actions won’t determine your character. You can be angry and still choose your next move carefully. You can remember what happened, set firm boundaries, and walk away without needing to cause the same pain you’re trying to move past.

That doesn’t mean pretending everything was okay. It doesn’t mean giving somebody access to you again. Sometimes the decision is simply: I know what happened, I know what I deserve, and I’m done putting myself in a position to experience it again.

Let your kindness come with boundaries. Let your trust take its time. Give yourself permission to move forward even if the apology never comes. You still have a life to enjoy, people to love, and things you want to accomplish.

That’s what makes a tattoo like this powerful. Simple lettering, a direct message, and a placement where you can look down and read it whenever you need that reminder. The meaning gives those words their weight.

Some days, you may read it and feel proud of how far you’ve come. Other days, you may need it to help you pause before reacting. Both are reasons to keep the reminder close.

You get to decide who you become after everything you’ve been through. 🖤

What’s a phrase you’d get tattooed to remind yourself of a lesson you never want to forget? 👇

 #MeaningfulTattoos #QuoteTattoo #LetteringTattoo #TattooInspiration

caption.text:
Love should never ask you to disappear. 🤍

You can give a lot to someone and still keep hold of yourself. The trouble starts quietly. You turn down an opportunity because his plans feel more urgent. You cover a bill to prove you’re serious. You swallow an opinion to keep the evening calm, then explain your worth once more to someone who isn’t listening.

None of it feels like losing yourself while it’s happening. It feels like being loving, patient and easy to be with. Then one day you notice how small your world has become, and how hard you’ve been working just to be chosen.

As a guy, I’ll be honest, a man who’s genuinely right for you won’t need you smaller. He won’t be threatened by your ambition, or make you beg for basic respect, or leave you guessing where you stand. Real love is clear, steady and intentional. Confusion isn’t a sign of depth, it’s a sign something’s missing.

So read the slides slowly and notice which one stings. That one is worth listening to.

The right relationship won’t cost you your self-respect. It will protect it.

Which one do you wish you’d learned sooner? Tell me below 👇

Send this to a woman who deserves to hear it.

caption.text:
There are so many versions of you asking to be heard.

The one craving a touch. The one desperate to be understood. The one running on empty, still chasing more.

The child in you carrying old wounds. The tired soul searching for somewhere to rest. The heart waiting for something that feels like home.

No wonder some days feel so heavy. You’re trying to care for every part of yourself at once.

🌹🤍

Btw, poetry book ‘Between Heaven & Earth’ is out now. It’s a collection of poems about love, heartbreak, loneliness, inner struggles, healing, and the quiet journey of understanding yourself and life along the way.

If you’d like to read it, comment “Book” and I’ll send you the link.

[poetry, poet, thefallenpoe.t, romances, innerhealing, selfdiscovery, emotionalneeds, poetrycommunity]

📍柳川川下り（福岡県柳川市）
🚣通常コースは約60〜70分の片道（松月乗船場→沖端・御花方面）、大人2,000〜2,200円前後
⏱️時間がない日は30〜40分の周遊ショートコースもあり（1,000円〜）。船会社で料金とコースが違います
🚃福岡・天神から西鉄特急で約50分、西鉄柳川駅から乗船場へ
🍂秋はしだれ柳とモミジの掘割。下船したら沖端で名物「うなぎのせいろ蒸し」が定番コース
